title: tehas plugin skills --json
description: What tehas plugin skills [--chat <host>] --json prints, version 1: the skills of every ready plugin that are granted at its pin, for one chat host or all (docs/specs/2026-11-21-plugins-v2-chats.md, "In the chat"). A chat host puts each text in its instructions after its own rules, labelled with the plugin's label, and marks what a turn with it proposed as shaped by that plugin; every entry carries its plugin, pin and label, so a host needs no second lookup. With chat set, only entries whose chats hold it are listed; with chat null, every granted skill is. An entry's commit is the plugin's pin, and a plugin is listed only when its state is ready at that commit and its manifest's sha256 is the one its build recorded. The text is read from the plugin's repository at that commit, never from what a run wrote, and sha256 is of those bytes. A refused plugin has no entry, nor will a held one once holds are built (spec 1.0.1, the inspection part). A text is at most 2048 bytes and all texts together at most TEHAS_PLUGIN_SKILLS_MAX bytes, both in UTF-8 bytes and enforced by the command; the schema's maxLength counts characters, so it is a looser bound. Plugins are a feature still being built, so this is not contract until the release that ships them. Every object is closed. The tests of console/core/src/plugin/schema.rs hold the sample beside this file to this schema.
